```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{LCSLength}{$X,Y,m,n$}
\If{$m=0$ \textbf{or} $n=0$}\State\Return 0\EndIf
\If{$X[m-1]=Y[n-1]$}\State\Return $1+$\Call{LCSLength}{$X,Y,m-1,n-1$}\EndIf
\State\Return $\max(\text{LCSLength}{X,Y,m-1,n},\text{LCSLength}{X,Y,m,n-1})$
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
